title: Error trend (hourly)
sqlTemplate: select histogram(_timestamp, '1 hour') as bucket, count(*) as error_count from _rumdata where service = {{service}} and env = {{environment}}{{version_clause}} and type = 'error' group by bucket order by bucket asc limit 200
emptyDataSemantics: No matching error records in the window -> an empty result set (zero rows/buckets), not a zero-valued row.
